name: Garland County, AR
findings: Garland County has 352 nonprofit organizations. 141 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 116 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Garland County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Health care organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 9 health care organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
